title: Brihadeeswarar Temple: the shadow myth
caption:
"Its shadow never touches the ground" ❌ MYTH. The truth is crazier 👇

📍 Brihadeeswarar Temple, Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu
👑 Built by Rajaraja Chola I, around 1010 CE (1,000+ years ago)
📏 Tower about 66 m tall, like a 20-storey building
🪨 Around 1,30,000 tonnes of granite, in flat Kaveri delta land with no granite hills nearby
🐘 The top stone is said to weigh about 80 tonnes. Legend says a ~6 km ramp was used to drag it up
🐂 The Nandi is carved from one single rock

☀️ The shadow is real: at noon it simply falls on the temple's own base.
UNESCO World Heritage Site (Great Living Chola Temples).
